abhivagga.p:
[Abhi+vagga] (pu) CL=7 Vagī-Saṃ. block-prohibit-expel-drive; one. Mass of inanimate and inanimate objects. William. Courage, power. William, Kotthubha. Abhivagga is probably a military weapon. In the case of weapons, it is not a light weapon that can be moved, but a heavy weapon that can be mounted somewhere. According to the explanations of commentary and sub-commentary, after it is hooked with sharp edges at the base teeth at the base and lifted up by a machine and set up the trigger, then dropped to torture and crush the enemy. One might wonder if it was a weapon named "Tone Maung" of the military weapons used in Eastern countries such as Burma.
